description: This file defines API routes related to exams within the backend API, including fetching exam configuration, starting an exam attempt, retrieving questions, and submitting answers. It uses FastAPI for routing, SQLAlchemy for database interactions, and relies on domain-specific flow functions and data schemas.

classes.name: ExamConfigResponse
classes.description: Response schema for exam configuration details.

classes.name: ExamStartResponse
classes.description: Response schema for starting an exam attempt.

classes.name: ExamSubmitRequest
classes.description: Request schema for submitting answers to an exam attempt.

classes.name: ExamSubmitResponse
classes.description: Response schema after submitting exam answers, including results.

methods.name: ExamConfigResponse get_exam_config(module_id: str, user: AuthUser = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Fetches exam configuration for a specific module, including duration, attempt limits, pass threshold, and question count.

methods.name: ExamStartResponse start_attempt(module_id: str, user: AuthUser = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Initiates a new exam attempt for a user on a specific module.

methods.name: list[Question] get_questions(module_id: str, user: AuthUser = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Retrieves questions for the active exam attempt without answers.

methods.name: ExamSubmitResponse submit_attempt(module_id: str, payload: ExamSubmitRequest, user: AuthUser = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Submits answers for an exam attempt, validates timing, and calculates results.
